_comment: Catalog of known object classes for similarity matching. A match here is a HINT, never an identification. Each entry cites the kb/ document that governs it, and those documents are now status: verified against real publications in sources/. The descriptor text itself is a synthesis written for matching, not a quotation, so entries carry status: derived. Numeric dimensions stay null: a fabricated size range would be treated as evidence by an operator. Add an 'embedding' array to every entry to match against your detection model's embedding space instead of the descriptor text.

objects.name: Moored contact mine
objects.descriptor: compact buoyant spherical or ovoid case suspended in the water column, thin near-vertical mooring line running down to a seabed sinker, moves with the tidal stream, horns or antennae on a smooth manufactured case
objects.confirms: a mooring line to a sinker, and horns or antennae on a smooth symmetrical case
objects.rules_out: an object resting on the seabed with no mooring line, or an irregular non-manufactured outline

objects.name: Bottom influence mine
objects.descriptor: regular cylinder resting on the seabed, often partly buried or scoured in, hard acoustic shadow, fires on magnetic acoustic or pressure signature rather than contact
objects.confirms: regular manufactured cylinder with a hard shadow, on or in the seabed, external fittings or lugs
objects.rules_out: irregular outline, natural material, or an object suspended in the water column

objects.name: Drifting mine
objects.descriptor: floating or near-surface case not moored to the bottom, usually a parted mooring, position not stable and any reported position ages quickly
objects.confirms: a mine case at or near the surface with a parted mooring cable and no sinker
objects.rules_out: a stable position over repeated passes, or contact on the seabed

objects.name: Unexploded ordnance, general
objects.descriptor: manufactured munition on or in the seabed, corroded casing, regular geometry, may be a shell bomb or torpedo body, age does not make it safe and corrosion can expose sensitised filling
objects.confirms: recognisable munition form, driving band, fin assembly, or fuze well
objects.rules_out: non-metallic material or an outline with no manufactured symmetry

objects.name: Shipwreck
objects.descriptor: large extended structure on the seabed with hull plate machinery and debris scatter, an orientation on the seabed, a least depth above the surrounding bed, often adjacent structural debris
objects.confirms: a match against the wreck registry on position least depth length beam and orientation, not on position alone
objects.rules_out: a compact isolated object with no debris field and no extended structure

objects.name: Structural debris
objects.descriptor: hull plate machinery and cargo fragments scattered on the seabed, often adjacent to a charted or uncharted wreck, irregular outlines and mixed sizes
objects.confirms: multiple irregular fragments in a scatter pattern near a wreck site
objects.rules_out: a single regular manufactured object with symmetry and a hard shadow

objects.name: Derelict fishing gear
objects.descriptor: nets longlines pots and cable, diffuse and irregular acoustic return, drapes over seabed features, primary entanglement threat to towed bodies thrusters and divers
objects.confirms: diffuse draping return with no rigid outline, netting or line visible on close inspection
objects.rules_out: a rigid symmetrical case with a hard shadow

objects.name: Drum, cylinder or pressure vessel of unknown contents
objects.descriptor: manufactured drum cylinder or pressure vessel of unknown contents on the seabed, regular geometry, chemical and containment hazard, handled as an unidentified object rather than as debris
objects.confirms: drum or cylinder form with closures or valve fittings
objects.rules_out: nothing rules this out at range; identification requires an authority

objects.name: Rock or geological feature
objects.descriptor: irregular discontinuous return with no manufactured symmetry, no straight edges, outcrop or boulder consistent with the surrounding seabed geology
objects.confirms: irregular outline consistent with surrounding geology across a second pass on a different heading
objects.rules_out: straight edges, symmetry, or regular manufactured geometry
